latest.title: Building an Agentic AI Helpdesk: Modernizing Enterprise IT Service Management with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
latest.description: Discover how to modernize enterprise IT helpdesks using Agentic AI on AWS. This article walks through a serverless architecture where Amazon Bedrock reasons over user intent by leveraging a Claude model routes incidents intelligently via MCP tools, and coordinates across Amazon DynamoDB, ServiceNow, and Amazon EventBridge — replacing manual triage with a conversational, auto-scaling AI agent built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

latest.title: Baking a Fast Lambda MicroVM: Lessons Learned in the Trenches
latest.description: Fresh MicroVM took 26s to mount a home directory. The mount itself was 0.6s — the rest was demand-paging the toolchain from snapshot storage at ~3MB/s. Fix: put the mount stack into tmpfs (anonymous memory survives snapshot capture, page cache doesn't). Got it to 11s. Lessons generalize to any snapshot-booted compute.

latest.title: Lambda MicroVMs + S3 Files: My Claude Code Sandbox for iPad
latest.description: Built a browser-based Claude Code sandbox on Lambda MicroVMs + S3 Files. Open a tab from iPad or laptop, land in a shell, close it, come back later — files and session intact. MicroVMs suspend when idle ($0 compute), S3 Files persists the home directory. One SAM template deploys everything. ~$10-37/mo. Full source on GitHub.

latest.title: Build It. Break It. Learn It. How 17 AWS Failures Made Me a Better Cloud Engineer
latest.description: A honest walkthrough of building a production event-driven microservices platform from scratch using ECS Fargate, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, Terraform, and GitHub Actions OIDC. No templates, no shortcuts, just real failures across infrastructure, CI/CD, networking, and application logic, and exactly how each one was fixed. Built so you can learn from the mistakes before you make them.
